description.p: HCX opens classic Macintosh HyperCard stacks (also inside MacBinary, BinHex, AppleDouble files and HFS disk images) and lets you browse their cards, buttons and fields. Linux port of pgostation's HCX.

description.p: Opens StuffIt archives (.sit, .sit.hqx) directly, much faster BinHex, and HyperTalk fixes found by testing the 847 stacks of the Pantechnicon collection.
AddColor colors, MACE and IMA compressed sounds, and many HyperTalk fixes found by testing 178 stacks. Scripts no longer freeze the window; Esc stops one.
First release for Linux, with a HyperTalk interpreter and native versions of common XCMDs.
